people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Then the princes said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah go hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are.”
translations.bsb: Then the officials said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah must hide yourselves and tell no one where you are.”
